How to Unstake Liquidity Pool:
1. In the Farms section in the token pivot table, select the required liquidity pair for unstaking. 

2. After selecting it and opening additional information, click on the “-” 

3. The “Unstake LP Tokens” window appears in which you need to specify the desired number of tokens for unstaking. 

4. Press “Confirm” and MetaMask shows up to confirm the operation, once again press “Confirm”. 

5. After this is complete, go to the Liquidity section. This section will display the previous pair of liquidity tokens that you staked. 

6. Select this pair and click “Remove”; then the window appears indicating the number of tokens for “split” 

7. Set the quantity to max and press “Approve”; you will see a MetaMask window. Click “Sign”. 

8. After that, the “Remove” button is unlocked to perform the final operation and split the liquidity tokens. Press it. 

9. Press “Confirm”. 

10. You get a message that the transaction has been sent and in some time you receive tokens back.

@iZiGame I will try to explain what farming means using the Beowulf  pinned message

Imagine um mercado onde exista uma banca de frutas em que são vendidas maçãs e laranjas. 
Digamos que um cliente chega na banca e deseje trocar suas maças por laranjas. Para isso, na banca já deve existir duas pilhas de frutas, uma de maçãs e outra de laranjas. 
Então, para efetuar a troca, o cliente deixa as suas maças na pilha de maças e pega a as laranjas (valor equivalente as maças que ele está trocando) na pilha de laranjas. 
Assim, para que esse sistema de trocas funcione é necessário a existência prévia das duas pilhas de frutas na banca. 
A “Liquidity Provider Fee" se refere a toda vez que um cliente fizer a troca, uma taxa é cobrada e será distribuída proporcionalmente a todos aqueles que contribuíram para a formação das duas pilhas de frutas. Para manter as duas pilhas de frutas com tamanho equivalentes, você é forçado pelo sistema a trazer 50% de cada fruta para a pilha. Depois que você depositar suas duas frutas na pilha, você recebe um token. Ele representa as frutas que você forneceu para o sistema. No futuro, você poderá usá-lo para recuperar as frutas que você disponibilizou. 
Outro incentivo para manter as duas pilhas de frutas sempre cheias é o “Token Farming”. Nesse caso, um cultivador decide criar um fundo de digamos 1 milhão de laranjas. Eles acordam que diariamente vão distribuir 10 mil laranjas para todos aqueles que contribuírem com as maças/laranjas da banca. Essa quantidade recebida será proporcional a quantidade de frutas que uma pessoa deixou nas duas pilhas.

    RESIDENTIAL – this is a location where a players’ character can live and can be of many property types, such as a skyscraper, a block of flats, a mansion, a house, a flat, a tent, etc.
    COMMERCIAL – this is a location where a player can create a business type such as a large shop, a bank, a tavern, etc.
    INDUSTRIAL – this is a location that processes resources for the player such as wood, food, water, metal, etc.
    AGRICULTURAL – this is a location that provides resources for the player such as raw food and plants, etc.
    RECREATIONAL – this is a location that provides fun things for your player to do, such as exercise or relaxation.

Flying Vehicles NFTs - we all like our independence and what better way to get around Cornucopias than your very own Bubblejett Sprinter. The amazing Bubblejett Sprinter comes in a limited number of colors - no need to use Public Transport when you have your own set of jets Vroooooommmmm!
Just read is LinkedIn profile. Looks good.

Mount NFTs - do you realize how big the 12 themed zones actually are? With 40 villages and lots of places to visit, getting around on foot is tiring and takes a lot of time. If you are into hiking you will love it but if you're like me and prefer a speedier way to get around the maps and enjoy a bit of company the upcoming mount NFTs are for you. Whether you need to fly, run or swim, a mount will be the perfect companion for you to hop onto and ride.

Pet NFTs - different to Mounts, Pets live on your Home Island Bubble and are free to roam around. Coming in all kinds of shapes, types and rarities your friends will love interacting with your Pets and they can visit your Home Island Bubble and bring theirs too - have a Pet Party!

Fish NFTs - are fish pets or are they something else? Who knows but in my mind they warrant their own category. We cater for all kinds of water and sea creatures on Cornucopias. Your Home Island Bubble is a FREE piece of land with an inviting water area already underneath waiting to be populated. What will you breed underneath your custom house - sharks, whales, crocodiles, tropical fish, mythical sea monsters? Your Home Island Bubble in Cornucopias is waiting for you to fill it up with NFTs and the drone interface allows you to zoom out of your 3rd person character and really explore yours or other habitats. Feel free to make videos exploring the varying Bubbles and see who is flexing the best and rarest NFTs.

Furniture NFTs - your custom house is just that - custom and you can buy or craft your own furniture into NFTs that you can show off in your house or sell on the open NFT marketplaces. The possibilities are endless. Checkout our video showing how Chad, our NPC, built and furnished his custom house ..

Island Homes NFTs - did I mention you start the game in your own FREE bubble that comes with a piece of land that is surrounded by an area of water? Well that's not all! You also start with 2 trees and a hammock - we really spoil you! Through playing the game, visiting the main themed zones and doing your daily Play-to-Earn (P2E) tasks you will be able to gather rewards and raw materials that will enable you to upgrade your Home Island Bubble and start building and furnishing your dream custom house. But guess what? When you have built and shared your masterpiece and you are ready for that next challenge you can convert your custom house to an NFT and sell it on the open NFT marketplace - complete with all the furnishings (if you want)! Then grind away and do it all again - what a fun way to Build-to-Earn (B2E).
NFT Character Clothing - there is no better way to uniquely show off your in-game character than to have a great wardrobe full of rare clothing NFTs. You can buy and sell these on the open marketplaces and craft and sell your own. In addition you probably have a blockchain wallet full of NFTs - what if they had increased utility in Cornucopias? What if your Cornucopias/Blockchain linked wallet(s) were so interconnected the NFTs in your wallet could be placed on your clothing and worn in-game? When you walk around the 12x Themed Zones and themed 12x City Districts every time you see a player with a rare NFT profile image on their T-Shirt you know the only way that is possible is because they own that NFT.

Cross Chain NFT Character Clothing - time to flex that rare SpaceBud or Bored Ape Yacht Club - you read that correct we are Blockchain agnostic you will be able to show NFTs from lots of Blockchains including Cardano, Ethereum, Solana, Immutable-X, Tezos to name but a few - and you don't need to convert them, we just read your wallet.
Cross Chain NFTs - I can hear you all now - what about my other NFTs that currently sit in my wallet and have no utility, how can I make more use of them? As mentioned above they can already be displayed on your as well as on other items in-game. For example on a picture in your Custom House, or on the side of various objects (more details on this in the future). But for some projects we will go a lot further with interoperability. Some NFTs unrelated to Cornucopias will find first class citizenship within our game. Through our partner network we will select quality projects and integrate them directly. Imagine racing a horse or car in Cornucopias using an NFT you had long forgotten about - did this game just get better and better?
NFT Tools - we all like a good toolbox don't we (maybe it's just me)? Well in Cornucopias you need tools to craft and do your daily tasks. All the tools in Cornucopias have a limited usage before they need repairing. By upgrading or buying rare tools from the open marketplaces, you will be able to stay in the forests longer, chopping down and gathering those raw wood materials, or with upgraded mining equipment you can mine that precious gold in less time.
